description: Parametric REGION verification via Parameter Lifting: a parametric Markov model + parameter region lifts to an INTERVAL MDP whose robust [pess,opt] reachability bounds the parametric value over the region — the reduction of storm-pars-style region checking to robust interval-MDP model checking, which IMPaCT already solves. Paper: Quatmann, Dehnert, Jansen, Junges, Katoen, 'Parameter Synthesis for Markov Models: Faster Than Ever', ATVA 2016 (DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-46520-3_4).
provenance: P(F target) = p; region p in [0.3,0.7] => value range [0.3,0.7]. Lifting is exact here (p occurs once per row).

measured.note: Live 2026-07-01. IMPaCT lifted region bounds [0.3,0.7] == Storm corner instantiations (p=0.3 -> 0.3, p=0.7 -> 0.7) == analytic. (storm-pars not built; corners confirm the endpoints; lifting handles the whole region in one interval-MDP solve.)
